# Mashed

> > Mashed is a food-focused publication covering celebrity chef insights, restaurant guides, cooking tips, and culinary culture from around the world.

Mashed features exclusive interviews with renowned chefs like Duff Goldman (Ace of Cakes, Holiday Baking Championship), comparative food analyses across different cuisines and regions, and practical kitchen advice ranging from essential tools to energy-saving tips. The site explores both home cooking and restaurant dining experiences.

## Key Topics

- Duff Goldman
- Celebrity chef advice
- Kitchen essentials and tools
- McDonald's international variations
- Restaurant dining tips
- Baking techniques
- Food health benefits
- Kitchen energy efficiency
- Regional food differences
- Fast food comparisons
- Digital kitchen scales
- Rolling pins
- American vs international cuisine
- Vegetarian dining
- Spicy food health studies

## Celebrity Chef Insights & Exclusive Interviews

- [2 Essential Tools Every Kitchen Needs, According To Duff Goldman - Exclusive](https://www.mashed.com/1113019/2-essential-tools-every-kitchen-needs-according-to-duff-goldman-exclusive/): Duff Goldman shares essential kitchen tools: rolling pin & digital scale

- [This One Household Kitchen Appliance Could Be Quietly Driving Up Your Utility Costs](https://www.mashed.com/1998267/household-kitchen-appliance-driving-up-utility-cost-ovens/): How electric ovens impact utility bills and energy costs in kitchens

## Restaurant & Dining Guides

- [You Should Think Twice Before Ordering Vegetarian Dishes At Restaurants](https://www.mashed.com/290138/you-should-think-twice-before-ordering-vegetarian-dishes-at-restaurants/): Chefs reveal why vegetarian restaurant dishes may not be best choice

## International Food Comparisons

- [How American McDonald's Burgers Differ From Italy's](https://www.mashed.com/312257/how-american-mcdonalds-burgers-differ-from-italys/): Comparing McDonald's burger menu variations between America and Italy

## Food Science & Health Studies

- [Study Reveals An Unexpected Benefit For Spicy Food Lovers](https://www.mashed.com/279750/study-reveals-an-unexpected-benefit-for-spicy-food-lovers/): American Heart Association study links spicy foods to health benefits
